issues.where: the shaken liquid, especially the lower and left half
issues.what: Broad opaque cream ribbons merge into a milky sheet at the bottom and across the cottage and pond. The target has a much more granular, sparkling storm that carries across the entire globe; distinct filaments and pinpoint glints layer over one another, with the lamp, trunk and pond still legible between them.
issues.fix: Break up the heavy bands into many finer, variably long curved streaks and recognizable seed silhouettes at several depths. Reduce the lower foreground smear and build up the finer, brighter streaks through the middle and crown.

issues.where: glass apex and shoulders, also present in set-B-01-b.jpg
issues.what: There is a conspicuous oval meniscus at the top and a hard white blade along the upper right; the target has no oval and shows a layered blue outer edge with finer warm arcs inside. The left reflection also blooms into too wide and flat a white patch, and the upper bowl reads hazier through the glass.
issues.fix: Remove the apex oval, replace the white blade with a narrower source highlight and separated warm and cool arcs, taper the lower-left reflection, and restore clear gaps and contrast between the reflections.

issues.where: front seat of the globe and base collar, also present in set-B-01-b.jpg
issues.what: A bright broad, nearly ruler-straight granular shelf and a long dark stripe make the bowl look perched on a machined lip. The target's darker rounded inner bank curves into a recessed seat with a much subtler contact shadow.
issues.fix: Round and irregularize the inner bank, darken its front face, break and narrow the bright shelf and dark stripe, and sink the bowl into the upper stone so a thinner contact shadow follows the glass curvature.

issues.where: cottage roof, chimney, wall and doorway
issues.what: The roof has repetitive exposed rows, the chimney is much taller and more regular, and the facade is evenly bright and covered in fine pink-green speckling. The target has a broader-looking dark textured roof, a squat darker chimney, irregular shaded stones, a pronounced stone arch, and larger, sparser flowering vines.
issues.fix: Shorten and darken the chimney, soften the roof rows, restore irregular masonry and a dimensional stone arch, and use more discrete flower and vine forms on the shaded wall. Preserve the same underlying construction in the shaken key.

issues.what: The crown is flattened and darkly speckled gold, with less warm rim lighting and fewer clearly separated lobes and branch gaps. The trunk has softer, more uniform orange shading than the target's sculpted roots and textured bark.
issues.fix: Keep the crown whole but restore rounded, tiered foliage masses, clear gaps, fine golden edge light, and more directional modeling on the branch junctions, bark and roots.

issues.what: The hanging lanterns and small cottage window read muted compared with the bright warm sources in the target. The lamppost looks like a plain stick with a square cap rather than the dark shaped post with a tapered lamp, and its reflection is lost.
issues.fix: Restore dimensional lantern glow with lit cores, brighten the window, refine the post and lantern housing, and carry a narrow coherent post reflection into the pond.

issues.where: fence, paths, foreground pond and planting
issues.what: The fence reads like a low continuous panel, the uniform bright grass and upright sunflowers look planted in a strip, and the pond edge bends into an abrupt straight corner with a broad anonymous bright reflection. The target has open rails, broken ground cover, a rounded uneven bank, and recognizable reflections of the tree and post.
issues.fix: Open up the fence rails, break up the grass line and flower spacing with layered moss and low plants, round the pond's shore around irregular stones, and reflect the actual interior silhouettes on shaded rippled water.

issues.what: Ignoring the intended particle types and colors, too much of the field reads as similarly round luminous disks or a fine static speckle, while seed detail is weak. The front, interior and back planes separate less clearly than in the target.
issues.fix: Keep the approved particle mix and color, but cut the largest uniform disks and give more seeds legible fine filaments and directional light, varying particle focus, size and local density to place them in depth.

issues.where: stone base from rim to foot, also present in set-B-02-b.jpg
issues.what: Apart from the intended carving depth, the base is taller and more uniformly turned, with mechanical horizontal rings and dark brown-gray shading. The target's lower foot and layered stone are more irregular, with textured pale ridges catching warm light and cool blue in shadow.
issues.fix: Lower and round the foot slightly, keep the carving depth but break up its long straight bands, and give the stone fine grain and the reference's warm and cool directional light.

issues.where: shell and sea-glass materials, also present in set-B-02-b.jpg
issues.what: The increased ornament is intended, but shells read dark metallic and the sea glass looks like glossy opaque cabochons rather than pale ridged shell and frosted, partly translucent glass.
issues.fix: Keep the added pieces but lighten the shells and give the glass frosted, irregular edges, internal color and softer reflections.

issues.where: surface around the foot and right-hand sand
issues.what: The right sand forms a larger, more isolated, smooth mound and lacks the fine backlit grains falling down the base's right edge. The surface around the foot reads flat and muddier, and it lacks the target's clean dark reflection and soft warm glints on the right.
issues.fix: Flatten and spread the sand into the contact area, add the thin localized backlit fall, and restore a restrained reflected silhouette and warm ripples on the shiny surface without reverting the intended left-side light pool.

issues.where: outside the bowl, across the base and at its foot
issues.what: Long falling streaks cross the front of the stone and a conspicuous band of fresh grains outlines the foot. The target's exterior fall is mostly a small backlit shower along the right edge and the front stays clean.
issues.fix: Confine the animated grains to the narrow right-side spill and remove the streak layer on the front of the base and the bright granular line around the foot.

issues.where: background light and overall color, also present in set-B-01-b.jpg
issues.what: The left lights become oversized soft brown patches, the high right lights are reduced to isolated round discs, and the lower right loses the layered warm reflections. The target separates deep cool blue-black from warmer light more clearly, with less olive-brown haze.
issues.fix: Match the size, contrast and layering of the peripheral bokeh and right-hand reflected lights, and restore cool dark separation against the warm highlights without adding compression texture.
